text_block_list.text:
Anxious about whether she can truly
finish 
the Japanese Derby, Matikanefukukitaru 
heads to a shrine to pray for divine help.

And with that... they bumped into Silence 
Suzuka, who was also running in the 
Japanese Derby.

She visited the shrine to pray,
determined 
not to be swallowed up by the demon of
the 
Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

Learning that even someone as talented as 
her worries about rivals, 
Matikanefukukitaru...

Her mind at ease, Matikanefukukitaru 
offered a prayer to the gods together
with 
Silence Suzuka.
